name: Basalt Hearthbearer

provenance.brief: Independent landmark-driven biped with fitted layered armor, articulated hands, a named weapon socket, readable windup/strike/recovery and a seven-clip native classic rig.

design_rationale: A basalt porter carries a repaired ceramic furnace as its own anatomy. Asymmetric exhausts, a narrow mask and open hands distinguish it from the reference giant. Mass, value hierarchy and deliberate anticipation are the lessons; no reference body/gear/frame is reused.
